periods.time: When Stella's group reaches the village below Edelberg
periods.location: Village at the foot of Edelberg, former Estonian territory
periods.summary: Stella, Ikki, Alice, and Tatara reach the lawless village below Edelberg, where armed Blazers have gathered to challenge Edelweiss. Gale's gang harasses Stella, but Lambert Rabe and Zenichi Kiba intervene and identify her and Alice. Rabe and Kiba reveal themselves as serious challengers, while Stella bypasses the competition by flying directly toward Edelweiss's mountaintop home.
periods.cause: News that Edelweiss is at home draws bounty hunters and elite challengers to the mountain.
periods.process: Alice explains the lawless territory; Gale attempts to claim Stella; Rabe greets Stella and Alice; Ikki recognizes Kiba from old sword records; Stella uses Dragon Wing to fly upward with Ikki and Alice while Tatara follows by reflecting force.
periods.outcome: The party reaches Edelweiss's high-altitude home without fighting the lower challengers, while Rabe and Kiba prepare to ascend later.
periods.significance: Introduces Edelberg as a lawless proving ground and establishes future opponents who will be defeated by Xiaoli.
